 "content": "from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    """Stamp the rare non-background colored pattern at every all-zero match."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0)
    marker = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == marker]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in points)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in points)
    shape = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in points]
    sh = max(r for r, c in shape) + 1
    sw = max(c for r, c in shape) + 1

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h-sh+1):
        for c in range(w-sw+1):
            cells = [(r+dr, c+dc) for dr, dc in shape]
            if all(grid[rr][cc] == 0 for rr, cc in cells):
                for rr, cc in cells:
                    out[rr][cc] = marker
    return out
"
